bullets.text: ROG Xbox Ally Tips - Enhance your gaming experience with essential tips for the new **Windows**-powered handheld.
Securing Customer Support - **Microsoft** emphasizes the need for robust security in customer support tools to prevent cyberattacks.
AI-Ready Oracle Database - **Microsoft** and **Oracle** enhance cloud capabilities with new features for AI integration.
AI in Cybersecurity - **Microsoft** introduces ExCyTIn-Bench, a new tool for evaluating AI in real-world cyber investigations.
Windows Copilot Updates - New features for **Copilot** on **Windows** enhance user experience with direct settings access.
AI Enthusiasts Rise - A new report highlights how users leveraging AI are experiencing increased ambition and confidence.
Building Security Culture - **Microsoft** focuses on fostering a proactive security culture among employees to combat cyber threats.
AI Transformation by Developers - Developers are at the forefront of AI adoption, reshaping enterprise operations and customer experiences.
Windows 11 Insider Builds - New updates for **Windows 11** Insider Preview enhance user settings and experience.
AI Infrastructure Expansion - **Microsoft Azure** launches a large-scale cluster with NVIDIA for advanced AI workloads.
